query:
INSERT INTO job_events (
            job_id,
            run_number,
            event_type,
            stage,
            payload
         )
         VALUES (
            $1,
            $2,
            'ENQUEUED',
            $3,
            jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
                'job_type', $4::text,
                'replayed_from_job_id', $5::uuid,
                'replayed_from_run_number', $6::int4,
                'replay_request_key', $7::text,
                'reason', $8::text
            ))
         )
